'''R2-T7''' was the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that served onboard [[Red Five/Legends|Red Five]] [[Grizz Frix/Legends|Grizz Frix's]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="Hasbro" /> in which the droid was destroyed along with Frix and his fighter.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
R2-T7 was created by [[Hasbro]] for a set of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side]]'' action figures based on the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> [[Grizz Frix/Legends|Frix's]] droid can be partially seen behind him in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']], though it does not match Hasbro's action figure of R2-T7, being a [[Color/Legends|white]]-domed [[R5-series astromech droid]].<ref name="ROTJ" />
